kz-0CRH.title: Vegetation: lush birch forests by green fields
kz-0CRH.summary: Lush birch forests beside green fields are common in the north. They look very like the area around Omsk in Russia.

kz-1BP4.title: Vegetation: pine forests with autumn colours
kz-1BP4.summary: Small groups or whole forests of mostly pine with some leafy trees showing autumn colours, around the city of Semey.

kz-1MSo.title: Lamps: sizable blue sensor on top
kz-1MSo.summary: Lamps with a big blue light sensor on top are found in the western town of Kulsary.

kz-2N2f.title: Pipes: gas pipes running above ground in towns
kz-2N2f.summary: Gas pipes running along buildings and streets are extremely common in towns and cities.

kz-2bcA.title: Houses: dirt line on the right of the roof
kz-2bcA.summary: A vertical line of dirt on the right side of a roof, east of Aktobe.

kz-362d.title: Landscape: sandy shrubby desert in the southwest
kz-362d.summary: Sandy, shrubby desert-like land is common in the southwest.

kz-538W.title: Road: crumbling edges, single white middle line
kz-538W.summary: Bad pavement with edges almost crumbling, and one white middle line, solid or dashed. Grassy steppe, some autumn trees, a low sun in the west. A short stretch east of the town has new pavement with a red tint.

kz-67Pc.title: Road: very bad quality, grey skies
kz-67Pc.summary: A road with poor pavement ranging from grainy to completely unpaved, mostly cloudy or overcast, through flat, semi-dry grass plains. Mostly driving north.

kz-6CPu.title: Landscape: mostly flat, so hills help
kz-6CPu.summary: The country is mostly flat, so hills or mountains help narrow it down. Hills near Karaganda and Aktobe, and bigger mountains in the south or east.

kz-6NZ7.title: Coverage: main roads and cities only
kz-6NZ7.summary: Most major roads and cities are covered, but small rural roads rarely are. Knowing which roads have coverage helps narrow your guess.

kz-7F8W.title: Poles: painted bands differ by region
kz-7F8W.summary: Pole paint colours (top to bottom) identify regions: west red-white-black, Atyrau blue-white-black, Akmola thin red then white then thin black, Kostanay thin turquoise and yellow, Petropavl white and grey, Taraz red-yellow-black, Kyzylorda thin yellow-red then white.

kz-7vOg.title: Landscape: grassy green rolling hills
kz-7vOg.summary: Grassy green rolling hills in the south, especially just north of the Kyrgyz capital.

kz-8SED.title: Plate: white with a hint of blue on the left
kz-8SED.summary: Through the blur, plates look mostly white with a small bit of blue on the left side.

kz-AQeC.title: Road: unpaved sandy desert road, blinding bright
kz-AQeC.summary: An unpaved sandy desert road near the Turkmenistan border in the southwest, with a landscape that is almost blindingly bright from the sand.

kz-DEVq.title: Lamps: three lamps in a rising row
kz-DEVq.summary: Some lamps have three separate lights in an ascending pattern, in the western city of Uralsk.

kz-Dsyl.title: Street signs on buildings: city styles
kz-Dsyl.summary: Designs vary, but a few are worth knowing: Aktobe's has half the sign taken by a QR code, Petropavl's is white with a blue semicircle, Astana's is a generic design, and Zhetisay's looks generic but is not found in two other southern cities.

kz-F1Ro.title: Coverage: only May coverage, sunny
kz-F1Ro.summary: The only coverage shot in May is in a small area east of the biggest city. It is all sunny, with mountains visible to the south.

kz-GFIL.title: Language: Cyrillic and Latin, Kazakh letters
kz-GFIL.summary: Signs use Cyrillic and Latin letters, and sometimes only Russian. Kazakh has extra letters such as Ә, Ғ, Қ, Ң, Ө, Ұ, Ү, Һ and І. Its Latin text can look like Turkish.

kz-IyXt.title: Buses: city-specific colours
kz-IyXt.summary: Aktobe orange and black, Zhezqazghan orange and white, Astana white-black-green electric, Karaganda turquoise, Semey light green and white, Almaty fully green with white patterns. Taraz buses look similar but say Taraz.

kz-Jgrt.title: Bus stops: city-specific designs
kz-Jgrt.summary: Useful stops: Atyrau modern white and neon green, Kostanay simple brown with a blue-yellow crest, Petropavl brown with an upward-angled roof, Karaganda old turquoise with a curved roof, Zhezqazghan very wide blue with two sections.

kz-LH5C.title: Landscape: ridge of hills to the north
kz-LH5C.summary: A low ridge of hills is visible to the north in much of the coverage of the southeastern town Taldykorgan.

kz-MhXe.title: Coverage: season tells you the region
kz-MhXe.summary: Coverage season hints at where you are: summer in the west and centre, autumn in the northeast, winter in the southeast.

kz-O76W.title: Bollard: post-Soviet type, 90-degree pair
kz-O76W.summary: Mixed post-Soviet style bollards, some like Turkish ones. The standout is a bollard made of two thin posts joined at a right angle, found only here.

kz-OjvE.title: Poles: more painted bands by city
kz-OjvE.summary: Less useful pole paints: Rudny red-yellow-red over white, Kokshetau light blue bottom, Shchuchinsk thin red and yellow, Ekibastuz blue and white, Shymkent thin yellow-red then green, Kentau blue-yellow-red then blue and black.

kz-PuS7.title: Chevron: yellow and black
kz-PuS7.summary: Curve chevrons are mostly yellow and black, unlike neighbouring countries. At T-junctions they are the usual red and white.

kz-RN95.title: Landscape: big, empty, flat and open
kz-RN95.summary: A huge country with deserts, grassy steppe, mountain passes and birch forests. Most rural coverage is very empty, open and mostly flat.

kz-TwXs.title: Street sign: letters under the QR code
kz-TwXs.summary: If you can read the letters under the QR code on a street sign, they tell you the region. This is rarely possible.

kz-ULz4.title: Road: 6-lane divided highway, quite green
kz-ULz4.summary: A 6-lane divided highway through quite green land with trees, grass plains or hills. Seen in both directions.

kz-UPTe.title: Driving direction on rural roads
kz-UPTe.summary: On a rural road, the direction the car is driving can help you narrow down where you are.

kz-V4BR.title: Infrastructure: looks like Russia
kz-V4BR.summary: Pedestrian signs, poles, houses and bollards all look very similar to Russia's, so look for other clues to separate them.

kz-W4LU.title: Lamps: thin grey with two small lights
kz-W4LU.summary: Thin grey lamps with two small light sources near the end are used throughout one southern city.

kz-WT7C.title: Plate: region code on trucks and buses
kz-WT7C.summary: The region code is sometimes visible on the back of trucks and buses. Codes follow alphabetical order of the regions. Buses and small utility vehicles are the most reliable, since cars travel.

kz-YIaa.title: Coverage: snow in the southeast
kz-YIaa.summary: Snow-covered coverage is found in the southeast, especially east of Almaty.

kz-YYgc.title: Landscape: dry shrubby hills, orange grass
kz-YYgc.summary: In the south near Uzbekistan: hilly, dry and shrubby with orange-looking grass, or dead flat farmland near Zhetisay. Red-and-white kilometre markers like Kyrgyz ones are only found near Zhetisay.

differs.how: Red-and-white KM markers here only appear near Zhetisay

kz-Zys3.title: Coverage: snowy mountains in a southern city
kz-Zys3.summary: In the south of the biggest city there is snow-covered mountain coverage.

kz-cODv.title: Road: divided asphalt, all white lines
kz-cODv.summary: A divided asphalt road running southeast to northwest with all white lines. It is green in the south and gets dry, sandy and shrubby in the north. Seen in both directions.

kz-dgAW.title: Road: divided highway, yellow edge lines
kz-dgAW.summary: A divided highway with yellow outer lines, running southeast to northwest through grassy, sometimes hilly steppe with occasional tree rows. Seen both ways.

kz-gVH6.title: Landscape: tall snow-capped mountains
kz-gVH6.summary: Tall mountains, often with snow on top, point to the southeast.

kz-hnfg.title: Sign: yellow-white crossing stripes
kz-hnfg.summary: Pedestrian crossings use yellow and white stripes as in Russia, but here there are often white dashes on both sides. Sometimes you see just the dashes.

differs.how: Russian stripes have no white dashes beside them

kz-iCTz.title: Road: cracked paving, no lines, overcast steppe
kz-iCTz.summary: Mostly paved but cracked road, almost without lines, under overcast skies, in slightly hilly steppe with yellow grass and red soil. A similar road is in better shape with faded dashed white middle lines.

kz-iCsU.title: Coverage: dense pine forests
kz-iCsU.summary: Coverage in dense pine forests is found north of the town Shchuchinsk, north of Astana. Pines also grow in other parts of the country.

kz-iVpz.title: Road: divided east-west, hilly steppe
kz-iVpz.summary: A divided road running east to west through hilly, less green steppe, mostly with yellow outer lines. Seen both ways.

kz-jwH7.title: Plants: tree trunks painted white at the base
kz-jwH7.summary: The bottom of tree trunks is very often painted white. This is also common in several eastern European countries and parts of Russia.

kz-k30n.title: Ornament: ram's-horn pattern
kz-k30n.summary: A decorative pattern called koshkar-muiz (ram's horns) appears on all kinds of decorations.

kz-kDlO.title: Road: under construction, yellow lines
kz-kDlO.summary: A road being widened, with yellow lines and a winter-dry, orange-brown steppe. The car drives south from Karaganda.

kz-kPVj.title: Landscape: hazy dead hills
kz-kPVj.summary: A hilly landscape that looks hazy and lifeless, with small mountains to the south or east of the road. The car drives east.

kz-m4nO.title: Phone numbers: area codes run east to west
kz-m4nO.summary: Area codes follow an east-to-west pattern along three horizontal bands. Worth learning.

kz-p3lc.title: Landscape: vast green plains
kz-p3lc.summary: Huge green grass plains in the northwest, especially in Akmola and Kostanay regions.

kz-qp33.title: Landscape: barren grass
kz-qp33.summary: A barren grassland with snowy mountains in every direction, some parts very snowy. In the east there is a small curvy mountain pass. This is a national park in the southeast.

kz-qqrg.title: Road: no lines, very dry red-orange land
kz-qqrg.summary: A road with no road lines through very dry, empty, slightly hilly land with red or orange soil, sunny with cumulus clouds. The car drives north.

kz-riSN.title: Coverage: hazy forest-fire smoke
kz-riSN.summary: Parts of the eastern city Oskemen have coverage with hazy forest-fire smoke.

kz-tkTf.title: Street sign: blue, on buildings, QR code
kz-tkTf.summary: Blue street signs fixed to buildings with white patterns at the top and bottom. They are often in two or three languages and may have a QR code. Designs vary even within one city.

kz-tn7H.title: Google car: white pickup, visible or blurred
kz-tn7H.summary: All coverage uses a white pickup truck, either fully visible or mostly blurred.

kz-uMOg.title: Entrance arcs: ornate arches at town entrances
kz-uMOg.summary: Many towns have an arch at the entrance, often quite detailed and ornate.

kz-uMS6.title: Vegetation: hilly forest with autumn colours
kz-uMS6.summary: Hilly, forested land with autumn colours, shot in October, in the far east. One town there is flat but ringed by hazy mountains.

kz-yBGD.title: Houses: yellow boxes on gas pipes
kz-yBGD.summary: Yellow boxes on the gas pipes outside houses are common in three southern towns.
